basic_details.job_title: NIMS Project Technical Support II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS) has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the Project Technical Support - II post under advertisement number AC-3/850/2026. The engagement is temporary for the duration of the project, with a pay of Rs. 26,000 pm. Candidates applying for the post must possess a 12th in Science plus MLT/DMLT with 5 years experience, or a three-year Graduate degree in life science with 2 years experience. Interested applicants must submit their offline application in the prescribed format along with attested copies of certificates to The Dean, Nizam's Institute of Medical

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 27 October 2026 (Within 15 days from the date of publication of this notification)

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Desirable Qualification Project Technical Support - II 12th in Science + MLT/DMLT+ 5 years experience OR Three year Graduate degree in life science+ 2 years experience Experience in Research

how_to_apply: Download the application format (Form-B) attached with the official notification.
Fill out the application form with all required details.
Attach attested copies of certificates supporting educational qualifications and experience.
Place the application and certificates in a sealed cover mentioning the notification number.
Submit or send the application by post to: The Dean, Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Panjagutta, Hyderabad - 500 082.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the required educational qualifications and age limits prescribed in the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: 12th in Science + MLT/DMLT+ 5 years experience OR Three year Graduate degree in life science+ 2 years experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 26,000/- per month, governed by ICMR guidelines applicable to staff. The duration of the appointment is tied to the project lifecycle and depends on performance appraisal. The appointment is purely on a temporary basis with no right to claim regular appointment in NIMS.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIMS Project Technical Support - II
content_sections.text: Download the application format (Form-B) attached with the official notification. Fill out the application form with all required details. Attach attested copies of certificates supporting educational qualifications and experience. Place the application and certificates in a sealed cover mentioning the notification number. Submit or send the application by post to: The Dean, Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Panjagutta, Hyderabad - 500 082.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the Project Technical Support - II post will be made through an interview. The interview is likely to be held in the third week of October, 2026. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or for joining the post.

rows.date: 27 October 2026 (Within 15 days from the date of publication of this notification)

faq.question: Q1. Is this Project Technical Support - II position permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The appointment is made purely on a temporary basis for the duration of the project, subject to performance appraisal, with no right to claim regular appointment in NIMS.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable as per Institute norms for reserved categories, provided the candidate is below 30 years of age.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a 12th in Science plus MLT/DMLT with 5 years experience, or a three-year Graduate degree in life science with 2 years experience.

faq.question: Q4. What documents need to be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose attested copies of certificates in support of all information furnished in the application form inside a sealed cover.
